BEHIND THE GLOBE

A new perspective.
A transparent dataset.

Atmos Atlas is an independent, interactive 3D concept inspired by the air-quality maps on IQAir. It is not affiliated with IQAir.

DEMO DATA

Every city reading, hourly trend, and coloured halo in this prototype is simulated. They do not represent current air quality, forecasts, a global average, or measured pollution coverage.

How to explore

Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate Earth. Scroll, pinch, or use + and − to zoom. Select a city to focus the globe and inspect its sample AQI and weather. Play the timeline to animate a fictional day.

Connecting the real world

Live readings can be added using the IQAir API and a secure backend. Access to individual pollutant concentrations depends on the API plan. API credentials should be kept on the server.
